drafted_from: tool:layer-pictures-over-video's own row in tools/media-composition/tool-rows.json, tools/media-composition/do-work/layer-over-video.mjs, tools/media-composition/test/layer-over-video.test.mjs, and the script run on a synthetic 7 second clip with a 200x100 logo
start_here: Say to your AI: "Put my logo in the top right corner of my video from second 1 to second 4, at 90% opacity." It runs tool:layer-pictures-over-video and saves the new video in your files.
no_lists_because: It makes a new video in your files from the video you name and keeps no list of its own.
instructions: 1. Find the identities in your files of the video and of each picture or b-roll clip (logo, photo, picture-in-picture).

2. Say "Lay this logo over the video" with video and pictures, back to front: each is {file, start (seconds into the video), optional to, x and y (0 to 1, where its centre sits), size (its width as a share of the frame, default 0.3), opacity, fade_in, fade_out, kind, from, label}.

3. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run and tool tool:layer-pictures-over-video. The door runs it in a container and answers {"result": {...}}; an error comes back as {"error": "what to change"}.
4. Read result (duration_seconds, bytes, pictures: how many were laid) and files.video, the new video in your files.

worked_examples.title: A logo in the top right for three seconds
worked_examples.ask: Put my logo in the top right from second 1 to 4.
worked_examples.given: read from tools/media-composition/do-work/layer-over-video.mjs (the translation is tested in tools/media-composition/test/layer-over-video.test.mjs) and run on a 7 second 320x180 clip: a still shows from its start for to minus from seconds
